pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 5.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we read a variety of materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a variety of texts for enjoyment and general understanding

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read a variety of texts for enjoyment and general understanding
   In simple words: practise until you can read a variety of texts for enjoyment and general understanding. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading.
4. Show that you can: read a variety of texts for enjoyment and general understanding

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Preview a text by focusing on the title, author, among others (fiction/ non-fiction) 1251- 1500 words),

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we read a variety of materials?
2. How do you identify the book you want to read?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read a variety of texts for enjoyment and general understanding

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
